movelist.name: Muddy Water
movelist.effect: As a Shift Action, the user may Move to any open square in Muddy Water’s area of effect without provoking any Attacks of Opportunity. On 16+, the Accuracy of all targets is lowered by 1.

movelist.name: Protect
movelist.effect: If the user is hit by a Move, the user may use Protect. The user is instead not hit by the Move. You do not take any damage nor are you affected by any of the Move’s effects.

movelist.name: Rock Slide
movelist.effect: Rock Slide Flinches all Legal Targets on 17+.

movelist.name: Mud Bomb
movelist.effect: The target’s Accuracy is lowered by -1 on 16+.

movelist.name: Bide
movelist.effect: The user may use Bide as a Reaction Move upon being Hit by a Damaging Move. During their next available turn, the user may Shift and then use Bide, causing all Adjacent foes to lose X HP, where X is the amount of Damage taken since declaring use of Bide (Loss of life through effects such as Poison is not ‘Damage’).

movelist.name: Mud Shot
movelist.effect: The target’s Speed is lowed by -1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.effect: The user gains Last Chance with Water.

abilities.name: Mud Dweller
abilities.effect: The user resists Ground-Type and Water-Type attacks one step further.

abilities.name: Regenerator
abilities.trigger: The user is recalled into a Poké Ball, or Takes
abilities.effect: The user gains Hit Points equal to 1/3rd of its maximum Hit Points. Regenerator may be activated only once per Scene.
